decision.scopeOfAccept: This ACCEPT is of harness.DR-G22.platform-abi-loader.v1 as a leftover-design specification of exact-byte intent for the four live DR-G22 retained-evidence members and the one live harness-cell corpus class, on the four D-002 platforms, at status CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED. It is not an application of platform-tcb-contract.v45, not a seal, not a SATISFIED of DR-126, and not a QUALIFIED. Per-OS allowlist rows, TCB filesystem selectors, version/build selectors, ikconfigParserVectors and NT-TCB-KEXEC all remain RESERVED, the matrix is INCOMPLETE on the filesystem selector axis, and leftover-design of OBL-G22-HARNESS-SPEC closes only on independent ACCEPT plus a later D-000 recording.
decision.summaryForCoordinator: No blockers, no SHOULD-FIX. The sharpest trap in this gate is that naming v6's executes limb says only 'Four D-002 platforms' while live file 08 says 'supported OS/filesystem/architecture' - the narrower phrase could be substituted silently. It is not: all three live tokens are carried, namedExecutesLimbNote says outright they are not optional, and the reconciliation is explicit, with OS x architecture giving the four cells and the filesystem token held as this gate's RESERVED TCB selector with the matrix declared INCOMPLETE. The second trap is the G07 boundary, since G07 EV-3 and G22 EV-1 both retain resolution evidence; the split is drawn the same way in both specifications - in-tree runtime libraries pinned to TreeCommitment stay G07, declared platform TCB / system-class resolution is this gate - and the two filesystem questions are separated into two distinct later acts with each file disclaiming the other's, so neither is orphaned. Verified against live bytes: 6/6 cited digests; all seven cell carries exact; both whole-row quotes byte-equal to the raw file-08 lines (526 and 387 characters); the six file-04 TCB lines exact with the paragraph boundary confirmed by the blank lines at 160 and 167; naming v6 executes, owner and standing exact with both limbs witnessed; v45's 8-member taxonomy carried exactly and reconciled to the live 6-token slash phrase without minting a fifth member; NT-TCB-1..4 name mappings correct against live v45 and held as cited-not-applied; g22VersusQualified, populatedTables, memberPopulation and tcbCarrier quoted accurately; D-125 dual ACCEPT and D-006's never-Rosetta rule confirmed from the governance record. Zero filesystem type tokens, no per-OS row, no D9 code, no 7.1 recipe, no Rust-as-core, no D-096 (A), required-now 26 unchanged. 30 attacks run, 30 refuted.
